title: Multiple JSON objects in package.json
evidence: package.json contains two top-level JSON objects
reproSteps: Open /workspace/package.json and note duplicate root objects.
scopeNote: May break tooling relying on strict JSON structure.

title: Vercel routes reference /api/auraFX and /api/noid without matching source files
evidence: vercel.json defines rewrites for /api/auraFX/* and /api/noid/*; src tree not enumerated for corresponding handlers.
reproSteps: Request /api/auraFX/ping in deployed environment; expect 404 if handler missing.
scopeNote: Potential dead routes reduce DX and may cause 404s.

title: Missing security headers at framework level
evidence: vercel.json sets custom headers but lacks common security headers like Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Frame-Options.
reproSteps: Inspect response headers in staging; verify absence of CSP/HSTS.

title: Sentry configured but not verified
evidence: @sentry/nextjs present in dependencies; no config file located in quick scan.
reproSteps: Search for sentry.client.config.ts or Sentry.init in the repo.
scopeNote: May miss error reporting if uninitialized.

title: Lighthouse CI autorun stubbed to pass
evidence: performance:audit script: 'lighthouse-ci autorun || echo "LH stub pass"'
reproSteps: Run npm run performance:audit locally; observe pass even on failure.
